_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Twenty-ninth scheduled run. 16 of 20 URLs served again -- full coverage of every site that has a product feed -- and 9,951 product pages reviewed. One new case: YOURROSES-074, "Party Trendsetter Rose Plant|潮流派对" against the chart entry "Trendsetter", status Abandoned, so it carries no enforceable right; classified Possible because the chart entry is a single ordinary word inside a longer title. Your Roses grew from 1,710 to 1,715 products and this was among the additions, so it is a genuinely new listing rather than a name newly compared. Captured the same morning.

The same seven listings remain removed, each re-confirmed by HTTP 404 on its own URL: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001 and -002, HILLSIDERO-004 and -005. These are restatements of removals already confirmed, not new events, and no Last Verified date moved. 375 of 382 cases re-verified; nothing was left unchecked.

Small growth elsewhere carrying no chart names: Mola Rose and Muse Roses 772 -> 773, Redland Ranch 1,849 -> 1,851, Rose Explosion 1,447 -> 1,448, Kate Roses 61 -> 62.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 166 products, unchanged. HILLSIDERO-004 and -005 remain removed; both URLs still return HTTP 404.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.
Served at 62 products, up one from 2026-10-21 and still refilling, but without KATEROSES-001 or -002, whose URLs still return HTTP 404.
Served at 1,715 products, up from 1,710 on 2026-10-21. One of the new listings matched a chart name and became YOURROSES-074 (Trendsetter, Abandoned -- no enforceable right).

screenshot_limitation: 330 of 382 cases carry a screenshot, including YOURROSES-074 captured today. The 52 without one each record why and none is a site that was simply not tried: High Garden 46 (7 Registered) -- the seller's pages blank themselves when they detect an automated browser, so these need manual capture and the measure was not bypassed; One Love 3 -- a membership login wall, also not bypassed; Flower Meadow Dream 3 -- listings removed by the seller, HTTP 404, nothing left to photograph.
